items.title: Please Don’t Sit on the Flowers
items.summary: Long-lost Georgia O’Keeffe landscape goes to auction, Brancusi gets lost at MoMA, interview with Doris Salcedo, and is showing at documenta worth it?

items.title: The Jewish Sisters in Renoir’s “Pink and Blue”
items.summary: Author Catherine Ostler follows the lives of the two cherubic girls, whose rarefied lives in an elite, artistic French family would be toppled by the horrors of the Holocaust.

items.title: Pablo Helguera to Helm the New School’s Vera List Center
items.summary: Upon his appointment, the artist reflected on the urgency he feels to “make sense of rapidly unfolding events, question prevailing narratives, and imagine alternative futures.”

items.title: Abstract Wool Compositions Cascade from Weathered Metal in Amine El Gotaibi’s Sculptures
items.summary: Amine El Gotaibi's new sculptures of metal and wool speak to the tensions between the land and the state and the ways we mark change. Do stories and artists like this matter to you? Become a Colossal…
